### Conventional Commit Type
- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `ci`: CI/CD pipeline or workflow changes
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `test`: New or modified tests
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavioral change

### Verification Checklist
- [ ] Linting passed (`make lint` / ruff + eslint)
- [ ] Unit & integration tests pass with coverage (`make test`)
- [ ] Docker images build cleanly without vulnerability alerts
- [ ] No secrets, keys, or credentials committed
- [ ] Verified locally via `docker-compose up`
